
============================================================
COMPUTING METRICS
============================================================

--- CBR-IDB ---
give me the number of patients who have been diagnosed with tobacco use disorder.
----------
PREDS:
SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHIC."SUBJECT_ID" ) 
FROM DEMOGRAPHIC 
INNER JOIN DIAGNOSES on DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = DIAGNOSES.HADM_ID 
WHERE DIAGNOSES."LONG_TITLE" = 'Tobacco use disorder'
{'sel': 'count', 'agg': ['demographic."subject_id"'], 'tab': ['demographic', 'diagnoses'], 'cond': [['diagnoses."long_title"', '=', 'tobacco use disorder']]}
----------
TRUTH:
SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHIC."SUBJECT_ID" ) FROM DEMOGRAPHIC INNER JOIN DIAGNOSES on DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = DIAGNOSES.HADM_ID WHERE DIAGNOSES."SHORT_TITLE" = "Tobacco use disorder"
{'sel': 'count', 'agg': ['demographic."subject_id"'], 'tab': ['demographic', 'diagnoses'], 'cond': [['diagnoses."short_title"', '=', 'tobacco use disorder']]}
----------

----------
PREDS:

AND DEMOGRAPHIC."ADMISSION_TYPE" = 'INPATIENT'

----------
TRUTH:
SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHIC."SUBJECT_ID" ) FROM DEMOGRAPHIC WHERE DEMOGRAPHIC."ADMISSION_LOCATION" = "TRANSFER FROM HOSP/EXTRAM" AND DEMOGRAPHIC."AGE" < "59"
{'sel': 'count', 'agg': ['demographic."subject_id"'], 'tab': ['demographic'], 'cond': [['demographic."admission_location"', '=', 'transfer from hosp/extram'], ['demographic."age"', '<', '59']]}

give me the number of patients less than 41 years who have delta abnormal lab test status.
----------
PREDS:
SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHIC."SUBJECT_ID" ) 
FROM DEMOGRAPHIC 
INNER JOIN LAB on DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = LAB.HADM_ID 
WHERE DEMOGRAPHIC."AGE" < 41 
AND LAB."FLAG" = "delta abnormal"
{'sel': 'count', 'agg': ['demographic."subject_id"'], 'tab': ['demographic', 'lab'], 'cond': [['demographic."age"', '<', '41'], ['lab."flag"', '=', 'delta abnormal']]}
----------
TRUTH:
SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHIC."SUBJECT_ID" ) FROM DEMOGRAPHIC INNER JOIN LAB on DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = LAB.HADM_ID WHERE DEMOGRAPHIC."AGE" < "41" AND LAB."FLAG" = "delta"
{'sel': 'count', 'agg': ['demographic."subject_id"'], 'tab': ['demographic', 'lab'], 'cond': [['demographic."age"', '<', '41'], ['lab."flag"', '=', 'delta']]}

AND PRESCRIPTIONS."DRUG_TYPE" = 'BASE'

{'sel': 'count', 'agg': ['demographic."subject_id"'], 'tab': ['demographic', 'diagnoses', 'prescriptions'], 'cond': [['diagnoses."short_title"', '=', 'diaphragmatic hernia'], ['prescriptions."drug_type"', '=', 'base']]}

give the number of patients who were diagnosed with personal history of colonic polyps and lab test result is abnormal.
----------
PREDS:
SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHIC."SUBJECT_ID" ) 
FROM DEMOGRAPHIC 
INNER JOIN DIAGNOSES ON DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = DIAGNOSES.HADM_ID 
WHERE DIAGNOSES."LONG_TITLE" = 'Personal history of colonic polyps' 
AND DEMOGRAPHIC."DIAGNOSIS" = 'ABNORMAL LABS'
{'sel': 'count', 'agg': ['demographic."subject_id"'], 'tab': ['demographic', 'diagnoses'], 'cond': [['demographic."diagnosis"', '=', 'abnormal labs'], ['diagnoses."long_title"', '=', 'personal history of colonic polyps']]}
----------
TRUTH:
SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHIC."SUBJECT_ID" ) FROM DEMOGRAPHIC INNER JOIN DIAGNOSES on DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = DIAGNOSES.HADM_ID INNER JOIN LAB on DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = LAB.HADM_ID WHERE DIAGNOSES."LONG_TITLE" = "Personal history of colonic polyps" AND LAB."FLAG" = "abnormal"
{'sel': 'count', 'agg': ['demographic."subject_id"'], 'tab': ['demographic', 'diagnoses', 'lab'], 'cond': [['diagnoses."long_title"', '=', 'personal history of colonic polyps'], ['lab."flag"', '=', 'abnormal']]}

How many patients had a lab test for sodium urine and were treated with a base drug?
----------
PREDS:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHIC."SUBJECT_ID") 
FROM DEMOGRAPHIC 
INNER JOIN LAB ON DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = LAB.HADM_ID 
INNER JOIN PRESCRIPTIONS ON DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = PRESCRIPTIONS.HADM_ID 
WHERE LAB."LABEL" = 'Sodium, Urine' 
AND PRESCRIPTIONS."DRUG_TYPE" = 'BASE'
{'sel': 'count', 'agg': ['demographic."subject_id"'], 'tab': ['demographic', 'lab', 'prescriptions'], 'cond': [['lab."label"', '=', 'sodium, urine'], ['prescriptions."drug_type"', '=', 'base']]}
----------
TRUTH:
SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHIC."SUBJECT_ID" ) FROM DEMOGRAPHIC INNER JOIN PRESCRIPTIONS on DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = PRESCRIPTIONS.HADM_ID INNER JOIN LAB on DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = LAB.HADM_ID WHERE PRESCRIPTIONS."DRUG_TYPE" = "MAIN" AND LAB."LABEL" = "Sodium, Urine"
{'sel': 'count', 'agg': ['demographic."subject_id"'], 'tab': ['demographic', 'prescriptions', 'lab'], 'cond': [['lab."label"', '=', 'sodium, urine'], ['prescriptions."drug_type"', '=', 'main']]}

how many patients of age less than 83 years had the drug ntgbase?
----------
PREDS:
SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHIC."SUBJECT_ID" ) 
FROM DEMOGRAPHIC 
INNER JOIN PRESCRIPTIONS on DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = PRESCRIPTIONS.HADM_ID 
WHERE DEMOGRAPHIC."AGE" < 83 AND PRESCRIPTIONS."DRUG" = "ntgbase"
{'sel': 'count', 'agg': ['demographic."subject_id"'], 'tab': ['demographic', 'prescriptions'], 'cond': [['demographic."age"', '<', '83'], ['prescriptions."drug"', '=', 'ntgbase']]}

how many patients stayed in hospital for more than 6 days and were diagnosed with orthostatic hypertension?
PRED: SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHIC."SUBJECT_ID" ) 
FROM DEMOGRAPHIC 
INNER JOIN DIAGNOSES ON DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = DIAGNOSES.HADM_ID 
WHERE DEMOGRAPHIC."DAYS_STAY" > 6 
AND DIAGNOSES."LONG_TITLE" = 'Orthostatic Hypertension'
